kpis.name_fr: Croissance des ventes en magasins comparables
kpis.description_fr: Variation annuelle des ventes pour les magasins américains ouverts depuis au moins un an, incluant les ventes en ligne.
kpis.description_en: Annual change in sales for U.S. stores open at least one year, including online ship-to-home and pick-up-in-store orders.
kpis._specific_to: Retail automotive parts industry metric; excludes new stores and specialty sales to isolate organic growth

kpis.description_fr: Ventes annuelles moyennes par magasin, pondérées par les dates d'ouverture, acquisition ou fermeture.
kpis.description_en: Annual average sales per store weighted for store opening, acquisition, and closure dates.
kpis._specific_to: Retail productivity metric specific to multi-unit automotive parts retailers; measures store-level performance efficiency

kpis.description_fr: Ventes annuelles par pied carré de surface de vente pondérées pour les opérations américaines et Porto Rico.
kpis.description_en: Annual sales per square foot of selling space weighted for U.S. and Puerto Rico store openings, acquisitions, and expansions.
kpis._specific_to: Retail space productivity metric; critical for automotive parts retailers to measure store footprint efficiency

kpis.description_fr: Ratio du coût des marchandises vendues sur 12 mois divisé par l'inventaire moyen des quatre trimestres.
kpis.description_en: Cost of goods sold for last 12 months divided by average inventory calculated from trailing four quarters.
kpis._specific_to: Working capital efficiency metric specific to parts distribution; measures inventory management and demand responsiveness

kpis.description_fr: Ratio des comptes créditeurs divisé par l'inventaire, mesurant le financement des stocks par les fournisseurs.
kpis.description_en: Accounts payable divided by inventory, measuring supplier financing of inventory.
kpis._specific_to: Cash conversion cycle metric; indicates working capital management and supplier payment terms leverage in parts retail
